brief: 기존 graph와 병렬로 관찰 사실만 저장하는 bounded Fact Code Graph를 구현하고 검증한다.

goals.title: Fact Graph domain model 구현
goals.objective: immutable node, edge, payload, graph, budget, diagnostic 모델과 invariant를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: Gradle compileJava completed for immutable fact domain records and invariants.

goals.title: Identity와 integrity support 구현
goals.objective: 결정적 ID, accumulator, integrity validator를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: Gradle compileJava completed for deterministic ID, accumulator, and integrity validator.

goals.title: AST visitor와 traversal policy 구현
goals.objective: 조건, 호출, 인자, field, outcome visitor와 내부 방문 정책을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: Gradle compileJava completed for AST visitors and traversal policy.

goals.title: Fact Graph builder 구현
goals.objective: API별 composite budget, cycle guard, diagnostic을 포함한 builder를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: Gradle compileJava completed for DefaultFactCodeGraphBuilder.

goals.title: Example-based tests 구현
goals.objective: domain, builder, branch, resolution, budget, cycle 테스트를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 6 example-based fact tests cover domain invariants, builder structure, local origin, enum constant, visited-method budget, edge budget, and recursive cycle reuse.

goals.title: jqwik properties 구현
goals.objective: identity 결정성과 graph invariant property를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 3 jqwik properties; tries 500, 500, 200; seeds recorded in JUnit XML; shrinking enabled.

goals.title: 전체 검증
goals.objective: 신규, baseline, legacy, 전체 테스트와 diff를 검증한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: full Gradle suite 53 tests, 0 failures/errors/skips across 15 suites; scoped diff check passed; legacy graph files unchanged; JUnit Platform resolved consistently to 1.9.3.

goals.title: jqwik IntRange import 복구
goals.objective: FactNodeIdGeneratorProperties에 jqwik constraints IntRange import를 추가하고 신규 테스트를 재실행한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: added net.jqwik.api.constraints.IntRange import; fact test compilation and execution succeeded.
